name: Réserve 1/2
source:
You play as one of the regular enemies from the first game, who, this time, must go and hunt humans. Lucifer (Satan in translation) has put out a reward for human girls, and it's up to you to bring them to him.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/pc98-reserve-1-1-6628055]Nana's Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演第一款游戏中的常规敌人之一，这一次，他必须去猎杀人类。路西法（撒旦）为人类女孩悬赏，你要把她们带到他面前。

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/pc98-reserve-1-1-6628055]Nana的Patreon[/url]]
